questions.text: Analyze the feelings of Ila towards Nanda using the verbs 'screwing up', 'stepping', 'flung', 'pecked' and 'crying'.
questions.explanation: Evaluative devices like 'delight', 'love', 'eagerly' and 'hideous' depict joy and admiration. Repetition of 'delight' stresses the feeling.

questions.text: Analyze Amir's perception of Hassan. How is the phrase 'open book' and the parallel structure 'the one who went to school... the smart one' used?
questions.explanation: Positive self-presentation via parallel structure vs. negative presentation of Hassan's illiteracy. Contrast between 'unsettling' and 'comfortable' shows contradictory character.

questions.text: Analyze the categorical assertion 'is/are' and the usuality modality 'always' in the Pashtun pride extract.
questions.explanation: Categorical assertions present belief as inescapable truth. Evaluative adjectives 'true' and 'pure' show pride and self-conceit.

questions.text: Analyze the Taliban member's description of the Mazar-i-Sharif massacre using 'guilt', 'remorse', 'virtuous', 'good', 'decent' and 'breathtaking'.
questions.explanation: Positive presentation of genocide as 'liberation'. 'Breathtaking' and 'God's work' show insensibility and manipulation.
